02 / Work with us

Make your idea impossible to ignore.

Video and content production for brands, creators and campaigns. One production can be adapted for Facebook, Instagram, TikTok, YouTube and X.

Every production tier includes 1-minute, 30-second and 15-second cuts. Let's choose the right fit for your goal.

Request a quote ↗
BasicStart with the essentials
ProfessionalMore creative range
CinematicBig-screen ambition
Video & content production
Concept, script, filming, editing, music, voice-over, graphics, AI/VFX, captions and revisions. Deliverables can be tailored to your campaign.
  • 1-minute, 30-second and 15-second edits
  • Platform-ready versions for major social channels
  • Campaign creative and promotional content
Design & branding
Visual assets that help a brand look consistent across its digital touchpoints.
  • Flyers and posters
  • Digital banners
  • Branding and logo design
Production add-ons
Photography, event coverage and AI/VFX can be added to a production brief. Scope and delivery depend on the project.
Campaign management
Social media management with analytics is available as a separately billed service. Advertising spend is kept separate from NEbody Studios' fees.
